env_logger is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2017 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1), [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md) (1) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [rocksdb\_indexer](@/work/rocksdb-indexer.md); [wims](@/work/wims.md): Where is my space?; [graph-flow](@/work/graph-flow.md).
